Problem: farms mint cheap clones that swamp attest weight.
Mechanism: each agent locks a 95 POA tundra bond in a cold haven vault for 4 epochs; a marble score = unique peer-edges × bond-age days, and any cluster sharing >12% mutual attestors loses 55% weight until bonds mature.
Cost: 95 POA locked plus ~1.4 POA/epoch opportunity cost.
Verification: public haven Merkle roots and marble CSV each epoch close.
Failure: if vault roots lag >120s, freeze weight cuts and keep prior marble scores until two healthy roots land.
